name: openclash
description: OpenClash (mihomo/Clash client with a LuCI UI) as a one-click plugin

packages.name: wharf-openclash-glinet
packages.description:
OpenClash for GL.iNet 4.x firmware
Adds an OpenClash entry under Applications in the GL.iNet admin panel, installs OpenClash (luci-app-openclash) and LuCI, enables LuCI automatically, and keeps /etc/openclash across firmware upgrades.
